name: Roommate Novel ~Satou Yuka~
original_name: ルームメイトノベル 〜佐藤由香〜
source:
It is summer and your parents left on holiday for all of August while leaving you alone with the house. One month complete of freedom. When suddenly destiny throws in a grain of salt. Sometimes one prefers to pass there evenings in the company of good friends and even a girl that you hardly know, meet the famous Sato Yuka!

[taken from [url=http://snesorama.us/board/showthread.php?t=18828]SNESorama Forum[/url]]
translation:
夏日里，父母整个8月都外出度假，把房子交给你独自照看。整整一个月，你都能自由自在地生活。可命运却突然为生活添了点意外。有时候，夜晚和好朋友相伴，或是与一个几乎不认识的女孩在一起，反而更让人喜欢。来认识大名鼎鼎的佐藤由香吧！

[摘自[url=http://snesorama.us/board/showthread.php?t=18828]SNESorama论坛[/url]]
